provenance.notes: KIT: the SunFounder Basic Starter Kit ships an ADS7830 module (see ads7830-module), not an ADS1115; there is no ADS1115 lesson, so 'not in kit'. PIN ORDER AND LAYOUT: the Adafruit front-photo pinout (STEMMA QT revision, product 1085) prints a bottom row VIN, GND, SCL, SDA, ADDR, ALRT and a top row A+, A3, A2, A1, A0, A- on the same 2.54 mm columns about 5 pitches apart (the row spacing is measured from the photo, +-0.3 pitch). Offsets put the bottom row at y = 0 and the A inputs on the top row. The A+ and A- pads are ADC power and ground outputs (VIN and GND through ferrites): 'these are OUTPUTs not inputs', so they are not modelled as pins. The silkscreen prints 'VIN' on this revision; the task brief and the chip datasheet call the pin VDD, so the pin id is VDD with the printed label VIN. The original Adafruit board (Eagle 'ADS1115_16Bit_I2C_ADC_v0.2') had a single 10-pin header (JP1) carrying VDD, GND, SCL, SDA, ADDR, ALERT and AIN0-AIN3 (the symbol's pin order is not a reliable physical order); the same signals are used here with the two-row layout of the current revision. CONNECTOR: Adafruit says the board 'Comes with a bit of 0.1 in standard header', unsoldered; the part assumes that header is soldered with its pins down as male pins. SUPPLY: Adafruit says 'Acceptable voltages are 2V to 5V' and the back silkscreen reads 'VLogic/Vin: 2-5VDC'; the TI datasheet (SBAS444E) says VDD 2.0-5.5 V (absolute maximum 7 V). The board limit 2-5 V is used for vccMinV and vccMaxV and the chip limit is kept as chipVddMinV and chipVddMaxV: conflict, the board limit is followed. I2C PULL-UPS: Adafruit's pinout page says 'SDA: This pin has a 10K pullup to VIN' and the same for SCL; both Adafruit schematics (the original and the 2022 rev C) show 10K resistors from SCL, SDA and ALERT to VDD and a 10K resistor from ADDR to GND ('Default I2C Address = 1001000'). The ALERT pull-up and the ADDR pull-down are read from the low-resolution schematic images, not from page text. So the I2C lines idle at the supply voltage: at a 5 V supply SDA and SCL sit at 5 V (SPEC 8 OVERVOLTAGE_GPIO); at 3.3 V they are Pi-safe. ADDRESS: TI datasheet Table 7-2: ADDR to GND = 1001000b (0x48), VDD = 0x49, SDA = 0x4A, SCL = 0x4B; the Adafruit table image agrees; the board's A0 jumper adds 1. PGA / DATA RATE: TI Table 7-1 full-scale ranges +-6.144, +-4.096, +-2.048, +-1.024, +-0.512, +-0.256 V; data rates 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 250, 475 and 860 SPS; 150 uA in continuous conversion. Do not apply more than VDD + 0.3 V to an analog input (TI). The digital pins SDA, SCL, ADDR and ALERT/RDY have a 5.5 V maximum (TI absolute maximum). I2C modes: standard 100 kHz, fast 400 kHz, high-speed 3.4 MHz (TI section 7). SIZE: Adafruit product page 25.4 x 17.8 x 4.6 mm. The 4 mounting holes are counted from the photo.
